newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 9.

text.p: CHINA TIMES - A planned new pro-independence group, the Nation-Building Party, is likely to have a significant impact on the Democratic Progressive Party.
Cheyne Chiu, Taiwan's representative in Singapore, is expected to become minister of personnel.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Chinese people in Taiwan, China, Hong Kong jointly condemn Japan as row over the disputed Diaoyu islands simmers.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - A power generator in Taiwan Power Company's Ta Lin factory explodes, no serious damage reported.
China to invite Taiwan aviation officials to discuss direct links at an academic seminar in December.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan to allow private companies to participate in seven telecommunications businesses two years from now.
Taiwan central bank plans to further lower banks' reserve requirements to boost the economy.
